title: "First flight of the U-2, 4 August 1955" (Chapter 2, p. 70)
description: Grainy black-and-white photograph showing a U-2 aircraft low over the dry lakebed with dust and light reflections, the aircraft only faintly discernible. Captioned "First flight of the U-2, 4 August 1955." The text recounts test pilot LeVier's landing attempts under Kelly Johnson's guidance and the "official" first flight on 8 August 1955 to 32,000 feet.
